question: Sanjukta Panigrahi a legendary dancer is associated with which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sanjukta Panigrahi** was a renowned **classical dancer **from India.
 
• She is most famously associated with the **Odissi** dance form.
 
• Odissi is one of the eight classical dance forms of India and originates from the state of Odisha.
 
• Sanjukta Panigrahi played a pivotal role in popularizing Odissi dance on the global stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Odissi dance is characterized by its fluid movements, intricate gestures, and expressive facial expressions.
 
• The dance form has a long history, with roots tracing back to ancient temples in Odisha, where it was performed as a form of worship.
 
• Sanjukta Panigrahi received numerous awards for her contributions to Odissi, including the **Padma Shri **and the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**.
